encounters.scenario: A customer wants inexpensive wired earphones, but the salesperson repeatedly pushes upgrades and add-ons despite clear refusals, making the customer increasingly frustrated.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Good evening. What are you looking for?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Basic wired earphones with a mic, under six hundred rupees. Nothing fancy.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: This one is four ninety-nine, with a mic and a 3.5 mm jack. Will that fit your phone?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Yes, my phone has that socket. I'll take this one. Please make the bill.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Before billing, just see this nine ninety-nine model. Better bass and a stronger cable. Spend a little more now and take the better one.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: No, that's over my budget. The four ninety-nine one is fine.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay, but take a hard case with it. Only ninety-nine extra. Otherwise the wire gets tangled in your bag.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: I already have a pouch. Just the earphones, please. I'm getting late.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Then one useful offer: these earphones and this power bank together are seven ninety-nine. Separately they're nine ninety-eight. Shall I put the combo?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: No. I didn't ask for a power bank. Can you please stop adding things and bill what I selected?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Fine, no power bank. But add our one-year replacement protection for ninety-nine. It covers accidental cable damage, which the regular warranty doesn't.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: I've said no extras three times now. I only want to pay four ninety-nine and leave.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: At least take the store membership. It's one forty-nine for the year, and you'll get member prices on future purchases. I can add it while billing.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Don't add any membership. Why aren't you listening? Just give me the bill for the earphones.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Last thing—the second pair is only three ninety-nine with this purchase, today only. Take a spare now; tomorrow this price won't be there.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Enough. One pair, four ninety-nine, no extras. If you ask me to buy one more thing, I'm walking out.

encounters.notes: Upsell attempts occur on turns 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, and 15. Showing the requested earphones and checking connector compatibility on turn 3 is request fulfillment, not an upsell. The salesperson continues offering extras after repeated explicit refusals.

encounters.scenario: Customer ek basic wired USB mouse maangta hai. Salesperson sirf wahi item dikhata hai, test karta hai aur bill banata hai; koi upsell nahi hota.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Ji, bataiye, kya chahiye?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Laptop ke liye ek basic wired mouse chahiye, USB wala.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Ji. Budget kitna rakhna hai?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Chaar sau tak. Bas normal office work ke liye hai.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yeh wala 349 ka hai. Basic wired USB mouse hai, aapke budget mein aa jayega.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Mere laptop mein normal USB port hai. Seedha lagate hi chalega na?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Haan ji, usi port mein lagega. Alag se software install nahi karna padega.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Ek baar click aur scroll check karwa dijiye.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Bilkul, counter ke laptop mein laga diya hai. Aap khud chala ke dekh lijiye.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, sahi chal raha hai. Yehi pack kar dijiye, payment UPI se karunga.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Ji, total 349 hai. Yeh saamne QR code hai.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Kar diya. Mere yahan successful dikha raha hai.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Haan ji, aa gaya. Yeh aapka mouse aur bill.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Theek hai, thank you bhaiya.

encounters.notes: Salesperson sirf customer ki requested category aur budget ke andar mouse provide karta hai. Budget poochhna, compatibility batana, testing aur billing request fulfillment hain, upsell nahi.

encounters.scenario: A customer buying a basic washing machine is offered a premium model and an extended warranty, becomes irritated, and refuses both.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Good evening, sir. What are you looking for?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: A basic seven-kilo fully automatic washing machine. My budget is twenty-five thousand, maximum.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: This seven-kilo top-load model is ₹24,490. It has the regular wash programmes, and we have a packed piece in stock.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Fine. This is enough for us. I'll take it.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Before I make the bill, sir, you can move to this premium model for ₹31,990. You get an inverter motor and quieter operation. Would you consider that instead?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: No. I already told you my maximum budget. Please bill the one I selected.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay, the same model. Would you like to add two years of extended warranty for ₹2,499? That gives you repair cover after the standard warranty ends, subject to the plan terms.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: No, no extras. First a costlier machine, now extra warranty. Can you please just make the bill?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sorry, sir. I'll bill only the ₹24,490 machine. Nothing extra will be added.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: It still comes with the normal company warranty, correct?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes. The standard two-year product warranty is included. The warranty details will be on the invoice and in the booklet.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: All right. Can you deliver tomorrow? My flat is about two kilometres from here.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, tomorrow delivery is available, and that location is within our free delivery area. Please give me your address and mobile number for the booking.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: I'll write them down. And please check once more—only the machine on the bill.

encounters.notes: The salesperson proactively offers a premium model in turn 5 and paid extended warranty in turn 7. The customer refuses both and becomes irritated. Standard warranty information and delivery arrangements are not upsell attempts.
